en.hubeali: From him, from his father, from Abu Abdullah Al Barqy, from Bakr Bin Muhammad, from Khasheyma who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who drinks Al-Suweyq for forty mornings, his shoulders would be filled with strength’.
en.sarwar: 12. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from his father from abu ‘Abd Allah, al-Barqiy from Bakr ibn Muhammad from Khaythamah who has said the following: “
If one drinks sawiq for forty mornings his shoulder will fill up with strength.’”
